articles.title: ‘The Diplomat’ Creator on Finally Tackling ‘Moral Toxic Waste’ in Trump Era: ‘Not Asking Those Questions Just Felt Absurd’
articles.summary: The article highlights 'The Diplomat' Season 4 creator Debora Cahn's distinctive approach to her political drama. This ensures the series offers a unique and engaging exploration of political themes, creating a fictional world separate from immediate real-world events.

articles.title: L&T-built INS Samarthak commissioned into Indian Navy, marking a milestone for private shipbuilding
articles.summary: The Indian Navy has commissioned "Samarthak," the first-of-class Multi-Purpose Vessel (MPV), designed and constructed by L&T Shipyard, at Karwar, Karnataka. This significant indigenous development highlights India's growing self-reliance in advanced warship building. "Samarthak" will enhance the Navy's operational flexibility and maritime security capabilities across diverse roles, reinforcing national defence preparedness and showcasing the strength of domestic shipbuilding.
